title: System
subtitle: Runtime health, readiness, and operational counters.
syncSubtitle: Is mail coming in? Each mailbox's last successful and last failed sync — problems first.
syncNone: This organization has no mailboxes yet.
queuesSubtitle: Every background queue across all organizations (system administrator only).
queueCleanupNote: Failed sync jobs are kept 7 days; jobs of deleted or disabled mailboxes are removed automatically.
workerOk: Background worker: running (sync, analysis, actions, alerts).
workerDown: Background worker: NOT running — no mail is synced, analysed or routed and no alerts are sent.
liveHint: New mail arrives within seconds (IMAP IDLE); polling is only a safety net.
jevRefusedExplain: Jev is refusing requests (HTTP {status}): the key, the plan or the credits. New emails wait unanalyzed until it is fixed.
jevErrorExplain: Jev's latest answer was an error. It usually clears on its own.
jevRetried: {ok} of {total} emails were analyzed and routed again.
jevRetryAfterFix: Fix the Jev account first — otherwise these will fail again.
jevRetryConfirmBody: {count} emails are sent to Jev again (each one is a billed analysis) and then routed with today's rules — their actions run.
